data.description:
## Context / Problem
After operation-family cutovers, leaving generic `_call_with_retry`, `_best_effort`, duck-typed production dispatch, or legacy write routes active would preserve retry multiplication and allow future code to bypass the coordinator. Preview/log consumers also need a stable versioned contract for lifecycle and deferred outcomes before expand can contract.

## Outcome
Finish the expand/contract migration: route every supported live mutation through typed plans/coordinator/adapters, remove obsolete physical-retry and write fallbacks, fail loudly for unsupported production paths, and seal manifests, logs, pass cursor/tallies, documentation, and local verified-fake validation. Preserve existing mutation shape while making lifecycle/retry/fuse outcomes explicit and observable.

## Plan
1. Inventory every Cloud/DC mutation leaf and prove it reaches the typed coordinator. Remove generic whole-operation retry, `_best_effort` write swallowing, production class-name/duck fallbacks, and duplicate SDK/adapter retry owners.
2. Keep compatibility only at serialized/public read boundaries. An unsupported live action raises a typed pre-effect error; tests may use explicit fakes implementing the declared protocol.
3. Finalize versioned preview/manifest sections for lifecycle intents, logical/physical attempts, delay source/value, budgets, scope, disposition, `retry_not_before`, fuse state, and exact per-ticket/pass outcomes. Redact secrets and bound diagnostic size.
4. Advance cursor/baseline/binding state only for proven postconditions. Deferred, failed, skipped, and commit-unknown work remains eligible for later re-observation and is never reported as applied.
5. Add ADR/docs for retry ownership, failure taxonomy, scoped fuse, label-first create containment, explicit behavior deltas, expand/contract rollback, and future adapter obligations. Run portable verified-fake Cloud/DC end-to-end tests; retain bounded live probes as optional operator evidence.

## Testing (RED → GREEN)
- A dispatch census test enumerates every `MutationDirection`/`MutationAction` and provider route, asserting one typed owner or an intentional pre-effect unsupported error.
- End-to-end fake Cloud/DC passes cover mixed success, transient recovery, long-delay deferral, permanent ticket failure, auth/provider stop, fuse open/reset, create containment, restart, and delivery failure.
- Golden preview/log/manifest tests pin existing mutation fields plus additive versioned sections, redaction, bounded diagnostics, and exact tally/exit semantics.
- Static/string and runtime poison tests fail if removed legacy helpers or hidden retries are reachable from production.

## Compatibility / rollback
Contract only after shadow parity and each family cutover test passes. A pre-contract release can revert per-family routing; after removal, rollback is a code revert that re-observes remote state and never compensates by deleting successful Jira work. Stored ticket/binding/event formats are unchanged; additive manifest fields are versioned and ignorable.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] A route census proves every supported Cloud/DC mutation uses exactly one typed coordinator/adapter path and no hidden SDK, generic wrapper, `_best_effort`, or duck-typed production fallback remains reachable.
- [ ] Unsupported production actions fail before local/remote effects with a typed provider-neutral error.
- [ ] Preview, manifest, and logs preserve existing mutation fields and add versioned redacted logical-attempt, lifecycle, delay/budget, disposition, fuse, and `retry_not_before` data.
- [ ] Cursor, baseline, and binding state advance only for proven postconditions; deferred/failed/skipped/commit-unknown work is never counted as applied and remains recoverable next pass.
- [ ] Portable verified-fake Cloud/DC end-to-end suites cover the approved taxonomy, retry envelope, fuse, create containment, restart, and partial-outcome behavior without external credentials.
- [ ] ADR and operator docs record ownership, intentional behavior changes, future adapter contract, no-dual-write cutover, and rollback that never deletes successful Jira work.
data.title: RP-03 S5 — Complete coordinator cutover and remove legacy write fallbacks
